note: Core Go snippets: a typed server handler and a schema-first HTTP client. The client uses Apache Arrow Go v18; see the guide for project setup and imports.

files.caption: Define parameters and wire schemas

files.name: client.go
files.caption: Build a batch and call the running server
files.code:
client, err := vgirpc.NewHttpClient(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8080",
    vgirpc.WithClientProtocol("Calculator"),
)
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
defer client.Close()

builder := array.NewRecordBuilder(memory.DefaultAllocator, paramsSchema)
defer builder.Release()
builder.Field(0).(*array.Float64Builder).Append(2)
builder.Field(1).(*array.Float64Builder).Append(3)
params := builder.NewRecordBatch()
defer params.Release()

result, err := client.CallUnary(
    context.Background(), "add", params, resultSchema,
)
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
defer result.Release()
fmt.Println(result.Batch.Column(0).(*array.Float64).Value(0)) // 5
